description:
Job Title: Alfresco Developer 
 Location: Bethesda, MD 
 Duration: Contract 
 
 Job Description: 
 · 4 - 8 years of experience in ECM / portal development 
 · Technical Skills –Alfresco, Liferay, Java EE7, JAVASCRIPT 
 · Worked on Webserver/Jboss or other J2EE Application server 
 · Experience working on onsite / offshore model 
 · Proficient in technical documents like UML, HLD, LLD 
 · Ability to design, propose and Implement solutions in Liferay and Alfresco 
 · Ability to provide solution design for RFP/RFI and present to wider audience 
 · Good communication and Presentation skills 
 Technical Skills –Alfresco: 
 · At least 2 – 3 years working experience in Alfresco (5.x preferred) 
 · Experience in integrating Alfresco with Security products (SAML, SSO) and Liferay 
 · Familiarity with Alfresco API 
 o Experience with Solr (OOTB) and custom dashlets 
 · Experience in large scale data migration to/from Alfresco 
 o Users and Permissions migration 
 Desirable skills: 
 · Self-Learner, Ability to pick up new technologies 
 · Ability to work based on deadlines 
 · Ability to work with customers through requirements capture, design, development and acceptance testing. 
 Technical Skills – Liferay (Optional): 
 · Experience in integrating with Security products (SAML, SSO) and Alfresco 
 o Experience with Solr 
 o Spring, Play Framework, JS Frameworks (AngularJS, ReactJS,…) preferred 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
